mapper.sql: f.id, f.user_id, f.file_name, f.file_path, f.file_size, f.file_type, f.status, f.create_time, f.update_time, u.username
mapper.select: SELECT FROM file f LEFT JOIN user u ON f.user_id = u.id WHERE f.status = 1 ORDER BY f.create_time DESC
SELECT FROM file f LEFT JOIN user u ON f.user_id = u.id WHERE f.id = #{id} AND f.status = 1
SELECT FROM file f LEFT JOIN user u ON f.user_id = u.id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.status = 1 ORDER BY f.create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO file (user_id, file_name, file_path, file_size, file_type, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{fileName}, #{filePath}, #{fileSize}, #{fileType}, #{status})
